fusions.name: Ride Down the Straggler
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health: you rush up to 7 tiles to it and strike for 20 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wide-Set Glare
fusions.desc: Your stare sweeps a wide 5-tile arc, dealing 26 damage that ignores resistance. Each hit has a 60% chance of [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Unbroken Sightline
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 54% further.

fusions.name: Sees Who Is Flagging
fusions.desc: Against an enemy below half health, you deal 15% more damage.
